findings.title: Rapid7 Analysis: CVE-2026-20127
findings.summary_md: Rapid7 reports that on 25 February 2026 Cisco published an advisory for CVE-2026-20127, a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) in the vdaemon service of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN (formerly Viptela) affecting Controller and Manager instances. The flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and gain administrative privileges, and Cisco confirmed in-the-wild exploitation.

findings.title: GreyNoise: Attacker surges preceded Cisco CVE-2026-20127 disclosure
findings.summary_md: GreyNoise observed eight distinct surges of Cisco-targeting attacker activity before the February 2026 CVE-2026-20127 disclosure, with the earliest surges beginning 39 days before the advisory and compressing to 2 days before publication. This indicates sustained pre-disclosure exploitation telemetry against Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN controllers.

findings.title: Critical Cisco Catalyst Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild (CVE-2026-20127)
findings.summary_md: Rapid7 confirms Cisco disclosed CVE-2026-20127 on 25 February 2026 with a CVSS 10.0 score, noting unauthenticated attackers can gain administrative access to SD-WAN Manager and Controller components. The advisory and CISA KEV addition followed active exploitation reports spanning multiple sectors.
